svg.title: CutLink Veal Cuts
svg.desc: Illustrative veal cut selector. Forequarter is a commercial composite shown schematically in the front region; tenderloin is internal. Visible colour paths are the click targets. The website must consume selection events.

g.title: Shoulder / Blade
g.desc: Includes Shoulder, Boneless Shoulder, Blade / Clod, Chuck, Chuck Tender.

g.title: Brisket / Breast
g.desc: Includes Brisket, Navel End Brisket, Breast.

g.data-subcuts: Rack,French-Trimmed Rack,Rib Set,Cube Roll / Rib Eye
g.title: Rack / Rib
g.desc: Includes Rack, French-Trimmed Rack, Rib Set, Cube Roll / Rib Eye.

g.title: Loin
g.desc: Includes Loin, Short Loin, Boneless Short Loin, Striploin, Backstrap.

g.data-subcuts: Leg,Boneless Leg,Topside / Inside,Inside Cap Off,Silverside,Outside,Outside Flat,Eye Round / Girello,Knuckle
g.title: Leg / Round
g.desc: Includes Leg, Boneless Leg, Topside / Inside, Inside Cap Off, Silverside, Outside, Outside Flat, Eye Round / Girello, Knuckle.

g.data-subcuts: Fore Shin / Shank,Hind Shin / Shank,Heel Muscle,Osso Buco
g.title: Shin / Shank
g.desc: Includes Fore Shin / Shank, Hind Shin / Shank, Heel Muscle, Osso Buco.

g.title: Trim / Manufacturing
g.desc: Includes Trimmings, Forequarter Meat, Hindquarter Meat, Diced Veal, Mince.

g.title: Bones / Offal
g.desc: Includes Bones, Marrow Bones, Liver, Kidney, Heart, Tongue, Cheek Meat.
